feed.title: Blog | Abdelwahab Mahmoud
feed.subtitle: Case studies and notes from building production systems.

entry.title: Handling backpressure in Node.js streams
entry.summary: A Node.js stream says slow down with one boolean. Ignore it and a single stalled client parks 200 MiB in your process. Here is how the signal travels.

entry.title: Building a booking marketplace from empty repo to beta
entry.summary: A booking marketplace from empty repo to beta. Why CI came in week one, and why double booking is a database problem, not a UI check.

entry.title: Preventing stock overselling in Redis with Lua scripts
entry.summary: Every Redis command is atomic. The check-then-write your app wraps around them is not, and that gap is how 100 units become 121 orders.

entry.title: Live order status over Socket.IO and Redis
entry.summary: Socket.IO delivers at most once by default, so live order status on a driver's phone is only as good as the Redis read it makes on reconnect.

entry.title: Extracting fulfillment from a PHP monolith over SQS
entry.summary: Fulfillment came out of a PHP monolith piece by piece, over SQS, so six people never froze features. The price was a contract both sides had to keep.

entry.title: Fixing 100% CPU on Aurora MySQL by removing a join
entry.summary: A status broadcast made about a thousand database calls, each scanning 7 million rows, and pinned Aurora at 100% CPU. The fix was a dropped join, not an index.

entry.title: Making LLM triage verdicts testable in code
entry.summary: Prompting an LLM to be careful never made pass/fail testable. Moving the verdict into code did, and replaying old incidents caught three false passes.

entry.title: Handling LLM rate limits as reschedules, not errors
entry.summary: Rate limits caused 65% of our LLM review failures. Treating them as reschedules, not errors, kept provider throttling from becoming our outage.

entry.title: Scaling ECS workers on queue depth without killing long jobs
entry.summary: ECS scale-in was killing translation jobs up to two hours into their run. Scaling on queue depth and letting busy tasks finish before they stop fixed it.
